create_calibrated_classifier: create a CalibratedClassifierCV with sigmoid method to calibrate RandomForestClassifier probabilities on validation data
generate_classification_dataset: generate a 3-class classification dataset with make_blobs containing 2000 samples and 2 features
plot_simplex_calibration: plot a 2-simplex with arrows showing uncalibrated to calibrated probability changes for each test sample
compute_log_loss: compute and compare log_loss of uncalibrated and calibrated classifier predictions on test data
compute_brier_score: compute and compare brier_score_loss of uncalibrated and calibrated classifier predictions on test data
